correctness.rationale: For a cut S, differentiation at 0+ includes |jump rate| on zero-edges and negative boundary loss on cut edges. Grouped by part pairs gives E(a,b,c,d;R)=ac|b-d|+bd|a-c|-ad(a+d+R)-bc(b+c+R); the integer inequality controls E≤0 when 2 max(part sizes)≤N+2, including +2 parity/integrality boundary. Coarea (nested level-cut decomposition) extends cut derivative bound to arbitrary real data, and time shift using H_s yields all-t contraction. Conversely a singleton from largest part s has derivative (N-s)(2s-N-2)>0 when threshold violated. Independently enumerated 2,492 bounded admissible pair tuples and checked exact inequality; finite checks support rather than prove all graphs.
